How freshness works

Flyers refresh daily and disappear after their end date or three days without a successful source check. Store directories and branch details refresh weekly; station coordinates refresh monthly. Conditional requests and a local cache avoid downloading unchanged pages.

Point rules are checked weekly. Changed sources enter a review queue; affected rates and point-card matches are suppressed until reviewed. Rules over fourteen days old also stop appearing as current. 0 flyer source errors in the latest run.

The 2.5 km limit is straight-line distance. Some publisher maps give an approximate location. Walking routes may be longer or require a detour. At a few stations only two or three options are within 1.5 km. We have not surveyed every local shop or visited every branch.
